name: Operations Research Honours

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The program requires the completion of 120 units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The Faculty of Science stipulates that a minimum of 48 units must be in upper division, and that additional upper division units will be required to total a minimum of 60.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In addition to the program requirements set out below, general university regulations must be met.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum program 3.00 cumulative grade point average (CGPA) must be obtained on the overall major program requirements, as well as a minimum program 3.00 grade point average in the upper division major courses.

sections.note: The specific requirements for this particular program are divided into three parts: required lower division courses, required upper division courses, and completion of an interdisciplinary requirement.

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: One of: CMPT 120 + CMPT 125; CMPT 130 + CMPT 135
One of MATH 150, MATH 151, MATH 154, MATH 157

sections.note:
Students complete
(Students transferring into a math program should contact the math undergraduate advisor if they have already completed equivalent courses.)

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a total of 48 units.

requirements.title: 5 of MATH 309, MATH 320, MATH 408 and 3 more
One of CMPT 305, CMPT 307, MACM 316 and 2 more
6 units from ECON 435
requirements.note: At least 6 additional units from the following list.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: To complete the required 48 upper division units, students complete additional coursework, of which at least two courses must be 400-level MATH or MACM courses with the possibility of substituting a 400-level course from another department subject to advisor approval.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: All courses pertaining to the required 48 upper division units must be approved by the program advisor in the Department of Mathematics.

sections.note:
Students complete a total of 48 units, including all of.
Any upper division STAT course except for STAT 302, STAT 305, STAT 310, STAT 311, STAT 320, and STAT 403.
Courses used to fulfil this upper division requirement cannot be used to satisfy the interdisciplinary requirement.
NOTE: SFU students accepted in the accelerated master’s within the Department of Mathematics may apply a maximum of 10 graduate course units, taken while completing the bachelor's degree, towards the upper division electives of the bachelor's program and the requirements of the master's degree.
For more information go to: https://www.sfu.ca/gradstudies/apply/programs/accelerated-masters.html .

sections.title: Interdisciplinary Requirement

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: With advisor approval, students also complete at least 15 units from application areas.

sections.note:
Application courses are chosen from ACMA, BUEC, BUS, CMPT, ECON, MACM, MATH, REM and STAT courses.
Courses used to fulfil upper division requirements cannot be used to fulfil this requirement.
If the operations research honours is completed as part of a second bachelor's degree, then the interdisciplinary requirement may be waived if the previous degree contains an approved major.
Approvals are given individually.
Those majors that are approved will not be limited to the disciplines listed above.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
